articles.summary: Heritage Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: HFWA) (the "Company" or "Heritage"), the parent company of Heritage Bank (the "Bank"), announces that Pat Casey will become the Executive Vice President and Chief Information Officer ("CIO") of Heritage Bank and Heritage, effective November 2, 2026. Mr. Casey brings expertise in data architecture and engineering, enterprise infrastructure, financial technology, and technology integration following mergers and acquisitions. His experience includes advising boards of directors and developing technology roadmaps that align IT capabilities with business priorities, as well as artificial intelligence strategy, cloud-native technology, cybersecurity leadership, and intelligent automation. He has held senior technology roles at Kite Realty Group, CNO Financial Group, Ahold Delhaize, and OfficeMax/Office Depot. articles.title: Pat Casey Named Chief Information Officer at Heritage Bank

articles.summary: Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Net income was $18.7 million, or $0.46 per diluted share, compared to $17.5 million, or $0.42 per diluted share, for the second quarter of 2026. Adjusted diluted earnings per share (1) were $0.55, compared to $0.57 in the second quarter of 2026. Net interest income increased $2.4 million, or 3.3% (13.0% annualized) from the prior quarter. Net interest margin increased to 4.05%, an increase of 6 basis points from 3.99% for the second quarter of 2026. Yield on loans increased to 5.76%, an increase of 4 basis points from 5.72% for the second quarter of 2026. Cost of interest bearing deposits decreased to 1.65%, from 1.67% for the second quarter of 2026. Loans receivable increased $133.5 million, or 2.3% (9.2% annualized), from the second quarter of 2026. Deposits increased $148.2 million, or 2.1% (8.4% annualized), from the second quarter of 2026.
